ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (25) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Разумный» (razumnyy, 'rational') is 'rational' throughout this reading, keeping it tied to «разум» (razum, 'reason'), and «мировоззрение» (mirovozzrenie) is 'worldview'. In the Buka passage «небесный отец, отец истины» (nebesnyy otets, otets istiny) keeps the lowercase 'heavenly father, the father of truth' of the print, and «блага» (blaga) is 'goods'; generic «человек» (chelovek) keeps 'he/him'.
